# Triggr

> Done-for-you AI automation and custom web development for Sydney trade businesses.

Triggr helps Sydney tradies (plumbers, electricians, builders, and similar operators) capture leads, respond in under 60 seconds, and follow up automatically. No agencies. No templates.

## Services

- AI automation: lead capture, instant SMS alerts, CRM wiring, follow-up sequences, custom workflows
- Web development: conversion-focused sites (typically $800–$1,200 build), hosting ($50–$100/mo), client portals, landing pages
- Automation pricing: starter setup $800–$1,500; full system $2,000–$3,500; retainers $150–$400/mo

## Location

Sydney, NSW, Australia
